Label: Low-Risk
Description: Healthy baseline population with minimal risk factors
Intervention_Strategy: Preventive care, health promotion, annual screening

Label: Socioeconomic Vulnerability
Description: High socioeconomic barriers limiting healthcare access
Intervention_Strategy: Free screening, community health workers, simplified education materials

Label: High-Risk Lifestyle
Description: Poor behavioral profiles with high intervention potential
Intervention_Strategy: Nutrition education, community exercise programs, cooking classes

Label: Chronic-Addiction Synergy
Description: Chronic disease burden compounded by addiction behaviors
Intervention_Strategy: Integrated chronic disease management, addiction treatment support

Label: Metabolic Extremes
Description: Severe obesity driving metabolic syndrome and diabetes
Intervention_Strategy: Weight management programs, dietary counseling, bariatric evaluation

Label: Frail Multi-Morbidity
Description: Multiple chronic conditions with complex care needs
Intervention_Strategy: Intensive case management, medication adherence, specialist referrals
